summary: The thunder spears crack Reiner's armor in Shiganshina. The weapon works, and it also kills the people who carry it. The Beast watches from the wall.

segments.ja: シガンシナで鎧が起きると、いつもの刃は表面を滑ります。滑ることを、班はオルブドの前から知っていました。知っていた不足を、雷槍が埋めます。雷槍は、刺さったあとで爆ぜる槍です。爆ぜる距離が、使う人間を危険にします。危険を、ハンジは対鎧の必要として配ります。配る相手は、リヴァイ班と、選ばれた兵士です。兵士は、友人の顔をした鎧にそれを向けます。
segments.en: When the Armor gets up in Shiganshina, the usual blade slides on the surface. The squad knew the sliding from before Orvud. The thunder spear fills the insufficiency they knew. A thunder spear is a spear that bursts after it sticks. The distance of the burst puts the human who uses it in danger. Hange distributes the danger as a necessity against armor. The people she distributes it to are the Levi squad and chosen soldiers. The soldiers aim it at an armor that has a friend's face.

segments.ja: 雷槍の前に、ライナーはエレンへ言葉を残そうとします。残そうとする言葉は、任務と、同期の記憶が混ざっています。混ざった言葉を、班は聞きながらも速度を落としません。落とさないことが、前夜の決断です。決断のうえで、ミカサが最初の角度を取ります。取る角度は、首の後ろの薄い線です。薄い線に、雷槍が続きます。続く武器は、会話を爆発で切ります。
segments.en: Before the thunder spears, Reiner tries to leave words for Eren. The words he tries to leave are a mix of the mission and the memory of classmates. The squad hears the mixed words and still does not drop its speed. Not dropping it is the decision of the night before. On top of the decision, Mikasa takes the first angle. The angle she takes is the thin line behind the neck. Thunder spears follow the thin line. The weapon that follows cuts the conversation with an explosion.

segments.ja: 雷槍が鎧の関節で炸裂します。炸裂は、刃が数年できなかった亀裂を一度で作ります。作る代償は、近すぎた兵士の体です。体を、班は英雄譚にはしません。しないまま、次の槍を続けます。続ける理由は、一度の亀裂ではライナーは止まらない、です。止まらない鎧が、街の家を壊しながら動きます。動く先に、エレンの家がまだ残っています。炸裂の煙が、隣の屋根へもう一回流れます。流れた煙の下で、次の槍が構えます。
segments.en: A thunder spear bursts at the armor's joint. The burst makes, in one time, a crack that blades could not make for years. The price of making it is the body of a soldier who was too near. The squad does not make the body into a hero tale. Without making it, they continue the next spear. The reason they continue is that one crack does not stop Reiner. The armor that does not stop moves while breaking the town's houses. Eren's house is still left ahead of the moving. The smoke of the burst flows once more onto the next roof. Under the smoke that flowed, the next spear is readied.

segments.ja: エレンは、硬質化の拳で鎧を家の方向から引き離します。引き離す役割は、雷槍の角度を作ることです。作るために、彼はライナーの注意を自分に集めます。集めることは、友人の顔を殴ることです。殴る拳に、罪の記憶が混ざります。混ざっても、彼は手順を捨てません。捨てない手順が、班の槍を生きたまま届けます。届けることが、今日の協力です。
segments.en: With a hardened fist, Eren pulls the Armor away from the direction of the house. The role of pulling is to make an angle for the thunder spears. To make it, he gathers Reiner's attention onto himself. Gathering it is hitting a friend's face. The memory of sin mixes into the fist that hits. Even mixed, he does not throw away the procedure. The procedure he does not throw away delivers the squad's spears while they are still alive. Delivering them is today's cooperation.

segments.ja: リヴァイは、雷槍の順番を短く切ります。切る指示は、同じ場所に二本、外れたら引け、です。引け、の意味は、爆発に自分を残すな、です。残すな、を、兵士の何人かは守れません。守れなかった名を、戦闘の途中では呼びません。呼ばない集中が、次の槍を正確にします。正確な槍が、鎧のうなじの蓋を割ります。割れた蓋の下に、ライナーの人間の顔があります。
segments.en: Levi cuts the order of the thunder spears short. The direction he cuts is: two on the same place, and if you miss, pull away. The meaning of pull away is: do not leave yourself in the explosion. Some of the soldiers cannot keep the do not leave. In the middle of the fight they do not call the names that could not keep it. The concentration of not calling makes the next spear exact. The exact spear splits the lid of the armor's nape. Under the split lid is Reiner's human face.

segments.en: While the thunder spears are splitting the armor, the Colossal does not appear. Not appearing does not release Hange's caution. The eyes that do not release keep looking at the town's barrels and the wall's shadow. The reason they keep looking is that Reiner may be buying time. Ahead of the time he may be buying is a barrel's fall. The fall is the next episode of the descent. Before the episode, the thunder spears deal only with the armor in front of them. Dealing with that is today's limit.

segments.en: Once, in the closeness of a thunder spear, Jean is between the order to pull away and the impulse to stay. He, who is between them, chooses the staying side. The reason he chooses is not to run from the wings' position. The choice not to run burns the edge of the explosion into his gear. Even burned, he does not fall. Not falling is the meaning of the polishing on the night before. The meaning is not becoming a hero. It is not abandoning his own turn. The scorch of the gear remains at the edge of an arm. He moves to the next angle without wiping the scorch that remained.

vocab.exampleEn: Before the thunder spears, Reiner tries to leave words for Eren. The words he tries to leave are a mix of the mission and the memory of classmates. The squad hears the mixed words and still does not drop its speed. Not dropping it is the decision of the night before. On top of the decision, Mikasa takes the first angle. The angle she takes is the thin line behind the neck. Thunder spears follow the thin line. The weapon that follows cuts the conversation with an explosion.

vocab.exampleJa: 許可の理由は、頁を爆発で失えば遠征の半分が消える、です。
vocab.exampleEn: The blast of the thunder spears breaks more of Shiganshina's houses. Not putting Eren's house inside the range of breaking is an unspoken order. Mikasa protects the order by position. The position she protects lowers the fight's efficiency a little. Levi permits the lowering. The reason for the permission is that if the page is lost to an explosion, half the expedition vanishes. So that it does not vanish, the spears' angle is drawn to the opposite of the house. Each time it is drawn, the soldiers' danger increases.

vocab.exampleJa: 雷槍の煙の下で、エレンの家はまだ扉を閉じています。
vocab.exampleEn: Under the thunder spears' smoke, Eren's house still has its door closed. He waits for the closed door until after the fight. The key that waits is hot at his neck. He does not grip now the heat it has. Not gripping is the order. Because of the order, the page has not been swallowed by an explosion. The page that has not been swallowed is this weapon's real protection. The protection does not return the dead. It does not return them, but it leaves half the expedition.

vocab.exampleJa: 止めにいく兵士が、近さの代償を払います。
vocab.exampleEn: Even with his face out, Reiner does not put the mission down. The body that does not put it down still makes a fist inside the split armor. The next thunder spear goes to stop the fist he makes. The soldier who goes to stop it pays the price of closeness. They count the name that was paid later. Before counting, the armor's movement clearly dulls. The dulling is the weapon's success. The success is not a clean capture. It is blood, a broken town, and an opened nape. Even with dulled movement, the fist still splits the town's stone. Soldiers step on the split stone and advance.

vocab.exampleJa: 証明前でも、彼の雷槍の手は揺れません。
vocab.exampleEn: Connie is looking at the Beast in the sky of the armor's fight. The hypothesis that the Beast he is looking at may be the cause of the village's emptiness is still before proof. Even before proof, his thunder-spear hand does not shake. The reason it does not shake is to stop the armor in front first. He checks the procedure of stopping back to back with Sasha. The two who check share the weapon's danger. Sharing is the substance of friends. The substance does not promise a clean return.

vocab.exampleJa: 炸裂の煙が、隣の屋根へもう一回流れます。
vocab.exampleEn: A thunder spear bursts at the armor's joint. The burst makes, in one time, a crack that blades could not make for years. The price of making it is the body of a soldier who was too near. The squad does not make the body into a hero tale. Without making it, they continue the next spear. The reason they continue is that one crack does not stop Reiner. The armor that does not stop moves while breaking the town's houses. Eren's house is still left ahead of the moving. The smoke of the burst flows once more onto the next roof. Under the smoke that flowed, the next spear is readied.
